about: Your own picks for Who's In. Add markets, free events and anything Ticketmaster misses. Use "days" for weekly events or "date" (YYYY-MM-DD) for one-offs. cat must be one of: gigs, comedy, sport, theatre, clubs, food, markets, free. region must be one of: Central, East, North, South, West.
